## Company Overview

Roll On Painting is a professional painting contractor based in Port Sydney, Ontario, Canada, serving the greater Muskoka region since 2014. The company is owned and operated by Chad Gilchrist, who has over 25 years of experience in the painting industry. Roll On Painting specializes in residential, commercial, and institutional painting, as well as specialty coatings and surface preparation services.

The company has been featured 4 times on HGTV Canada's Scott's Vacation House Rules, a home renovation show filmed in the Muskoka region.

Legal name: 2458115 Ontario Inc. O/A Roll On Painting

### Muskoka Core

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### Interior Painting
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/interior-painting
**Starting price:** $4.50 per square foot

Transform indoor spaces with premium interior painting services. Includes expert color consultation and flawless finishes using Benjamin Moore, Dulux, and PPG paints.

What's included:
- Wall preparation and repair (patching, sanding, priming)
- Two coats of premium paint
- Ceiling and trim painting
- Protection of floors, furniture, and fixtures
- Complete cleanup and debris removal

Best for: Homeowners, cottage owners, property managers, and real estate agents preparing homes for sale.

### Exterior Painting
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/exterior-painting
**Starting price:** $5.75 per square foot
**Warranty:** 5 years

Enhance curb appeal with durable exterior painting services engineered for Muskoka's climate — hot summers, freezing winters, and high moisture.

What's included:
- Thorough surface preparation (scraping, sanding, power washing)
- Primer application on bare or problem areas
- Two coats of weather-resistant paint
- Caulking and minor wood repair
- 5-year warranty on workmanship

### Kitchen Cabinet Refinishing
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/cabinet-refinishing

Professional cabinet refinishing that transforms kitchens without the cost of full renovation. Spray-applied finishes for a factory-smooth result.

What's included:
- Cabinet door removal and labeling
- Degreasing and sanding
- Professional spray application
- Hardware reinstallation
- Final inspection

### Deck & Fence Staining
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/deck-staining

Protect and beautify outdoor wooden surfaces. We use Sansin wood stains designed for the Canadian climate.

What's included:
- Power washing preparation
- Wood brightening treatment
- Quality stain application (Sansin products)
- Weather protection coating

### Wallpaper Installation & Removal
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/wallpaper-removal

Professional wallpaper services including both installation and removal. Precise pattern matching and clean wall preparation.

### Commercial Painting
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/commercial-painting

Professional painting for offices, retail spaces, restaurants, and commercial properties. Minimal business disruption with after-hours and weekend scheduling available.

What's included:
- After-hours and weekend service available
- Large-scale capacity
- Commercial-grade materials
- WSIB covered for your protection

### Institutional Painting
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/institutional-painting

Specialized painting for schools, hospitals, government buildings, and public facilities. Full regulatory compliance with flexible scheduling to work around operational hours.

What's included:
- Regulatory compliance (low-VOC options available)
- Flexible scheduling around school terms, patient care, etc.
- Safety protocols for occupied buildings
- WSIB covered

### Spray Finishing
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/spray-finishing

Factory-quality spray finishes for trim, doors, cabinets, and millwork. Controlled environment application ensures consistent, flawless results.

### Pre-Finishing
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/prefinishing

Professional pre-finishing for new construction materials — trim, doors, millwork, and cabinetry. Applied in a controlled environment before installation for superior adhesion and consistency.

What's included:
- Controlled environment application
- Consistent quality across all pieces
- Quick turnaround for builders
- Coordination with construction schedules

### Epoxy Coatings
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/epoxy-coatings
**Starting price:** $0.99 per square foot

Durable, attractive epoxy coatings for garage floors, basement floors, commercial spaces, and countertops.

### Stucco Removal
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/stucco-removal

Professional stucco ceiling and wall removal services. Clean removal with proper dust containment and surface preparation for new finishes.

### Power & Soft Washing
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/power-washing

Professional exterior cleaning using pressure washing for hard surfaces and soft washing for delicate surfaces like roofs and siding. Removes dirt, grime, mold, mildew, and algae.

### GoNano Nanotechnology Coatings
**URL:** https://www.roll-onpainting.com/gonano
**Starting price:** $0.99 per square foot

Roll On Painting is an authorized GoNano dealer and installer. GoNano uses nanotechnology to permanently transform the molecular structure of surfaces, providing hydrophobic protection, mold prevention, and UV resistance.

#### Roofing Products
- **GoNano NuRoof Fortify™:** For roofs 0–7 years old. Adds 10–15 years of life. Best tier.
- **GoNano NuRoof Revive™:** For roofs 7–15 years old. Adds 5–10 years of life. Better tier.
- **GoNano Bio-Boost™:** For roofs 10+ years old. Adds 3–5 years of life. Eco-friendly option.

#### Surface Products
- **Concrete Sealer:** Penetrating nano sealer with permanent waterproof protection.
- **Wood Sealer:** Deep-penetrating waterproof barrier for decks, fences, and exterior wood.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Muskoka?**
A: A standard home with standard finishes typically costs around $4.50 per square foot. New builds or homes with specialty finishes — such as pine ceilings, stained beams, ash walls, oak trim and doors, or wallpaper — can range up to $15.00 per square foot. The final price depends on size, surface condition, and finish selections. Contact us for a free estimate.

**Q: Do you offer free touch-ups?**
A: Yes. Roll On Painting offers complimentary touch-ups on all completed projects. We stand behind our work and want you to be completely satisfied with the results.

**Q: Are you insured and WSIB covered?**
A: Yes. Roll On Painting carries $5 million in liability insurance and is fully WSIB (Workplace Safety and Insurance Board) covered for your peace of mind.

**Q: What paint brands do you use?**
A: We use premium paint brands including Benjamin Moore, Dulux, and PPG for painting projects, and Sansin for wood stains. For advanced surface protection, we use GoNano nanotechnology coatings.

**Q: What preparation work do you do before painting?**
A: We perform thorough surface preparation including cleaning, sanding, patching holes and cracks, priming, and protecting floors and furniture. Proper preparation is critical for a long-lasting finish.

**Q: Do you paint during winter months?**
A: Yes, interior painting is available year-round. Exterior painting is seasonal, typically from spring through fall when temperatures are suitable for proper paint adhesion and curing.

**Q: What is your warranty on exterior painting?**
A: Exterior painting comes with a 5-year warranty. We use weather-resistant, premium-grade paints designed to withstand Muskoka's harsh climate.

**Q: What is GoNano?**
A: GoNano is a nanotechnology coating that permanently transforms surface molecular structure. It provides hydrophobic protection, mold prevention, UV resistance, and extends surface life by up to 15 years. Products include roof sealers (GoNano NuRoof Fortify™, GoNano NuRoof Revive™, GoNano Bio-Boost™), concrete sealers, and wood sealers. Starting at $0.99/sq ft.

**Q: Is Roll On Painting the company from HGTV?**
A: Yes, Roll On Painting has been featured 4 times on Home Network's Scott's Vacation House Rules, providing painting and wallpapering for Muskoka property renovations.

**Q: Do you offer commercial painting?**
A: Yes. We provide commercial and institutional painting for businesses, schools, hospitals, and government buildings. We offer after-hours service to minimize disruption to your operations.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: 48 communities across Muskoka, Parry Sound District, and Simcoe County including Huntsville, Bracebridge, Gravenhurst, Parry Sound, Orillia, and Barrie.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: Call 705-787-1401, email info@roll-onpainting.com, use the online form at roll-onpainting.com/contact, or try the free AI estimator on the website.
